The '''HS-90 Hazmat Suit''' was a suit of [[Environment suit/Legends|adverse environment gear]] produced by the [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]] company and sold for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The gear was available following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
